title: Good Times Bad Times: The Premium Stays with the Strait
section_path: Good Times Bad Times: The Premium Stays with the Strait
section_path_text: Good Times Bad Times: The Premium Stays with the Strait
summary:
Main
By Nikolas Zannikos
In October, we wrote that if the transfer network off Oman kept pace, Gulf crude would carry China's refill and keep drawing tonnage east, supporting earnings on both routes. The earnings split: freight outside the Strait gave back most of its gains, while freight inside it held on. The cost of chartering a VLCC from the Gulf of Oman to China (TD34) reached 841 Worldscale on 8 October, the highest level since the route began to be assessed in March.

children.summary: TD3C runs from Ras Tanura to Ningbo, about 10% further than TD34 from Mina Al Fahal. Yet on 8 October TD3C was assessed at 1.6 times TD34 in Worldscale points, and on 20 November at 3.1 times.

children.title: Tonnage tightened, then recovered
children.summary:
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-25 123128.png | assets/2026-11-25_good-times-bad-times-the-premium-stays-with-the-strait_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_4178e4756c82.png
Figure 2 shows the Gulf tonnage pool: unsanctioned VLCCs, on spot and on contract, that could reach the Arabian Gulf within 30 days of their next open date. It is a wider measure than the net supply count.

children.title: The relay through Fujairah kept running
section_path: The relay through Fujairah kept running
children.section_path_text: The relay through Fujairah kept running
children.summary:
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-25 123139.png | assets/2026-11-25_good-times-bad-times-the-premium-stays-with-the-strait_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_0e1d2607d22d.png
Over the past 60 days, 77% of VLCC loading calls at Fujairah were at the anchorage, where cargo is transferred from other vessels, and 21% at the ADCOP single buoy mooring, which loads crude piped from Abu Dhabi. Where the delivering vessel can be identified, it is almost always another VLCC shuttling cargo out through the Strait.
